notes.title: New art style
notes.notes: Defence Club: Rouge Patrol is being updated with a new art style for the character models. You can already check it out in the demo. Enjoy!

notes.title: Demo of Rouge Patrol is live for Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello to everyone, I am pleased to announce Rouge Patrol is participating in Next Fest and, as such, its Demo is now live!!

I hope you enjoy this first chapter of Rouge Patrol and getting to know the girls. Remember to Wishlist if you want to see more!
